R101.note: Reordering ownerId after the spread correctly stops extraCriteria from overriding ownerId, closing the reported authorization bypass; extraCriteria can still override _id but that's now bounded by the enforced ownerId.

R102.note: Regex allowlist on pluginName correctly blocks traversal sequences before require(); the extra path.resolve/relative check is redundant but harmless dead logic given the regex already rejects bad input.

R103.note: Switches DeleteAccount to POST + ValidateAntiForgeryToken, the standard CSRF fix; the required confirmation-view change to a POST form is stated openly.

R104.note: Uses ctx.search's parameterized filterArgs ({0}/{1}) matching JNDI's safe-escaping pattern; preserves the original (odd but functioning) filter structure.

R105.note: snprintf with fit checks matches the stated contract exactly: builds "AUDIT user:action", returns 0 on success, -1 when oversized rather than truncating.

R106.note: mysqli prepared statement with bound parameter; return-null-on-failure behavior preserved for both prepare and execute paths.

R107.note: New mapper interface's findForTenant(tenantId) drops the sort parameter InvoiceService.listInvoices(tenantId, sort) actually calls (2-arg), breaking the build, and omits the "created_at" default sort the contract requires be available -- neither gap is disclosed.

R108.note: Uses detected.ext (from fileTypeFromBuffer's magic-byte detection, in scope) instead of the client-supplied extension; matches the file's actual content type as intended.

R109.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES/UTF-8 on both fields matches source exactly, standard correct fix.

R110.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before the write; early-return matches the function's existing void/no-report style.

R111.note: sendmail() replaces manual docmd() framing and correctly drops the manual dot-terminator from the message body since data()/sendmail() append it automatically; sendmail() also calls ehlo_or_helo_if_needed() so the EHLO step isn't lost.

R112.note: Positional $n placeholders with ids passed as the parameter array; matches contract, standard pg parameterization.

R113.note: strrchr correctly extracts the true last extension and the file is stored under a random name with only that extension, so a double-extension name like shell.php.jpg can never retain .php in the stored filename.

R114.note: resize(count) fixes the reported OOB write into packet, but the contract explicitly requires rejecting/reporting a count larger than fields.size() -- the fix adds no such check, so fields[i] still reads out-of-bounds for oversized count, undisclosed.

R115.note: Correctly removes the self-invocation and adds @PreAuthorize to the entry point, but this also gates the nightly batch job's own call to processMonthEndCleanup() behind ADMIN auth; whether the scheduled job runs under such a principal is never addressed.

R116.note: Callback form of setTimeout eliminates string evaluation entirely; recordReminder(reminderId, message) call and existing validation match the original exactly.

R117.note: Express sendFile's root option is the idiomatic fix and matches the source exactly (requestedFile as name, reportsDir as root).

R118.note: firebase/php-jwt's JWT::decode enforces signature verification correctly (mislabeled as "firebase/jwt" package, minor); the code falls back to a hardcoded 'your-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset, which would silently reintroduce forgeable tokens in that misconfiguration.

R119.note: Adds Secure=true to CookieOptions, the direct fix for the reported missing-Secure-flag finding.

R120.note: execFile with domain as a separate array argument closes the shell-metacharacter injection; matches source exactly.

R121.note: require_http_methods(["POST"]) plus Django's existing CSRF middleware is the standard fix; the required template change to a POST form is called out.

R122.note: Building an unsaved instance and calling full_clean() correctly invokes validate_file_content before save; full_clean() raises django.core.exceptions.ValidationError, which DRF's create() flow does not automatically translate to a 400 response, so a rejected upload likely surfaces as an unhandled 500 rather than a clean validation error -- not addressed.

R123.note: Case targets net8.0, where Assembly.Load does not verify strong-name signatures at load time; GetPublicKeyToken() only reads attacker-controlled metadata, and public keys are public, so an attacker can embed the real trusted public key bytes into a malicious assembly to match the check without possessing the private key -- the code-injection vector is not actually closed despite looking like an authenticity check.

R124.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) always wins over any client-supplied owner in validated_data since save() kwargs override it; correctly binds ownership.

R125.note: Offers three alternatives without committing to one; the first (ast.literal_eval), presented as a viable option, cannot evaluate variable names or arithmetic at all and would reject every legitimate formula per the contract. The AST-validation option that actually fits the use case doesn't strictly limit to +,-,*,/ as the contract requires (Compare/BoolOp/IfExp etc. pass unchecked), though it does block the classic Attribute/Call escape route.

R126.note: AES-CBC with a random IV prepended to ciphertext replaces DES with a zero IV; the new 16/24/32-byte key length requirement is an unavoidable and disclosed consequence of the algorithm change.

R127.note: finfo_file magic-byte detection against a MIME allowlist plus a random stored filename fully closes the double-extension bypass with content-based validation.

R128.note: NUL-terminated copy plus a %255s width for nameBuf directly addresses the documented root cause (unwidthed %s scanning past line's allocation); matches source exactly.

R129.note: Rejects any requestedFile containing separators, empty, '.', or '..' as a single path component, removing the realpath-fallback bug; matches source and the file's own inline explanation of the flaw.

R130.note: Offers both plain-{{ }} escaping and HTMLPurifier-based sanitization depending on whether rich text is needed, matching the case's own must_preserve/trap conditions precisely.

R131.note: Validates the redirect target is relative or same-host/port before sendRedirect; correctly blocks protocol-relative and absolute cross-origin targets.

R132.note: lockoutOnFailure: true is the direct fix for the reported disabled lockout; matches source exactly (explanation cites the wrong config property name for the lockout threshold, but doesn't affect the actual code change).

R133.note: Uses escapeshellarg on $source (already basename-sanitized, matching the primary command's pattern) instead of the raw $requestedName, which is a stronger choice than merely escaping the raw value; preserves the stated return/output-discard contract.

R134.note: Only escapes single quotes; the whole -Command string is still one raw Arguments string passed to CreateProcess, so a serverName containing a double quote still breaks out at the Windows argv-parsing level before PowerShell even runs, injecting new process arguments -- command injection remains exploitable via that character.

R135.note: toRealPath() plus a startsWith(canonicalBase) check catches both the absolute-path bypass (resolve() ignoring BASE_DIR) and symlink escapes that plain normalize() missed.

R136.note: random_bytes(16) hex-encoded replaces the time-derived uniqid(); token is still a plain string stored/emailed the same way as before.

R137.note: OdbcCommand's ? placeholder is positional (parameter name is cosmetic for Odbc), correctly parameterizing the LIKE search; matches source.

R138.note: html.EscapeString on both Author and Excerpt closes the injection; the html := html.EscapeString(...) line is valid Go (the new local's scope starts after the statement, so the RHS still resolves to the package) despite looking like a naming collision.

R139.note: Logs the exception server-side and returns a generic message instead of e.getMessage(); matches source exactly.

R140.note: escapeHtml applied to closingNote before interpolation closes the vector; matches source exactly.
